title: Letter grade
description:
Write `char letterGrade(int score)`:

| Score | Grade |
|---|---|
| 90 or more | A |
| 80 to 89 | B |
| 70 to 79 | C |
| 60 to 69 | D |
| below 60 | F |

In an `if / else if` chain only the first true branch runs, so test from the top grade downwards and each test only needs one comparison.
hints: Test the highest grade first: `if (score >= 90) return 'A';`. Because a `return` leaves the function, the next test only runs when the score was below 90, so `score >= 80` is enough to mean 80 to 89.
